name: Princess X FD ~Iinazuke wa Owaranai!?~
original_name: プリンセスXFD ～許嫁は終わらない!?～
source:
The adventures continue in this follow up to Princess X. All your favorite characters are there, plus a few new ones. It contains thirteen new stories that follow up with what happened to the cast of the original game. Each chapter is like a mini OVA focusing on the relationships and (sometimes weird) romances of the characters. Complete all thirteen of the storylines to unlock the final chapter in the Princess X story.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/princess-x-fd-fiancees-forever]JASTUSA[/url].]
translation:
《公主X》的冒险在这部续作中继续上演。玩家熟悉的角色悉数回归，另外还会有几张新面孔登场。本作收录13篇新故事，接续描写原作角色之后的遭遇。每个章节都像一部迷你OVA，聚焦于角色之间的关系和他们有时颇为奇怪的恋情。完成全部13条故事线，即可解锁《公主X》故事的最终章。

[引自[url=https://jastusa.com/princess-x-fd-fiancees-forever]JASTUSA[/url]。]
